title: What Godly Brotherhood Actually Costs a Man
caption:
You don't find brotherhood. You pay for it.

Not with money. With the highlight reel you'd rather keep up, the easy friendship you'd rather not trade, and the correction you'd rather not sit with.

Real brotherhood costs something every time, and it's worth more than what it costs. Two or three men who actually have your number. Who know your sin. Who show up.

Who's actually in your corner right now?

#godlymen #christianbrotherhood #accountability #faith #community
